name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Raspberry Peach
description:
Indulge in the perfect balance of tart and sweet with our Raspberry Peach BITEZ gummies! Featuring a luscious combination of tangy raspberries and juicy peach, these double-layered treats deliver bold flavor with every chew. Infused with a potent mix of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP, each gummy boasts 1,000mg per piece, ensuring a long-lasting and blissful experience. With two in every pack, your taste buds and senses are in for a treat!

Raspberry Peach layers bold Raspberry with juicy Peach flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
